prompts.red: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: eight transparent retro tactical RPG magic-effect sprites in exactly FOUR columns TWO rows, equal cells, no text or lines. TOP ROW: four RED life-drain energy orbs growing from a tiny core to medium open ring to large turbulent red sphere to compact gathered core; only red/pink energy, not blood or gore. BOTTOM ROW: four extraction motifs: a small inward curling red spiral drawing energy from a victim; a tapered curving red ribbon pointing RIGHT with detached red motes trailing LEFT; a second thinner rightward wisp; a small red energy droplet/mote with a sharp right-pointing tail. Extraction motifs should clearly imply suction from left toward right, delicate spirals and tapering particle strands. Polished crisp stepped pixel art, three flat tones muted deep crimson #7e3641, warm red #bd5860, soft light red #eda79d, no orange/yellow/blue. No blurry bloom, no gradients, no white flashes. Isolated motifs centered in their own cells, fully intact particles/tails, large clear transparent gutters. No person, weapon, icons, UI, arrows drawn as signs, text, background, floor or shadow. Genuinely transparent background.
prompts.spring: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: SIX frames of healing water accumulating into a shallow GREEN spring, tactical RPG pixel art, exactly THREE columns TWO rows on truly transparent background. Equal cells and consistent ground baseline per row, all frames same camera. Reading order: 1 tiny green droplets strike and form a small oval puddle; 2 a wider pale green puddle with little crown splashes; 3 fuller shallow green spring with gentle ripples; 4 large quiet oval green pool with two upward water curls and fading droplets above; 5 same broad pool with ripples settling; 6 pool becoming thinner/smaller with last small green droplets, fading ending. The pool is liquid water, not grass, slime, a ring portal, green fire, or a solid pedestal. Clear flat oval perspective, thin layered ripples, gentle water splashes. Only soft three-tone greens #356e4e #70b67d #c4e9b5 to match approved healing effect, no blue, yellow, white or gray. Crisp stepped pixel silhouette, graphic flat color blocks, avoid glossy gradients, blur and excessive glow. Six isolated effects fully intact with transparent gaps; no text, labels, grid lines, background, floor, rocks, people, plants, icons or UI. Keep complete droplets and pool boundaries within each cell.
